C0416.title: Microsoft 365 MFA Bypass Incident
C0416.summary: An attacker successfully logged into a corporate Microsoft 365 account using only single-factor authentication despite security defaults being enabled. The user had set up the Microsoft Authenticator app for MFA, but sign-in logs showed that multi-factor authentication had been bypassed. The poster asked about possible MFA bypass causes and sought directions for investigation. The case highlights the need to examine sign-in logs, conditional access policies, and authentication method configuration to confirm whether protection is actually effective.
